title: CLAUDE.md: EXIT_CODES wording overstates the one type-to-code map
description: Follow-up filed from the #44 review (reviewer unit glyph-cli-review-44, verdict APPROVED). CLAUDE.md's repository-profile command-surface bullet says the exit-code family is "mapped once in EXIT_CODES", which overstates the map: EXIT_CODES covers only the GlyphErrorType codes 2-7 (src/errors.ts:12-24), while 0 and 1 are the separate EXIT_OK and EXIT_UNCAUGHT constants (src/errors.ts:12-13), combined with EXIT_CODES only by exitCodeTaxonomy() (src/contract.ts:44-46, whose own comment reads "ok and uncaught are codes, not GlyphErrorTypes; the rest come from one map"). Reviewer's suggested wording: "codes in src/errors.ts with EXIT_CODES the one type-to-code map, and exitCodeTaxonomy() adding ok and uncaught". The bullet is this repository's own governing prose, so the final wording belongs to the worker that edits it. The eight-code list GCLI-16 added must not regress. Docs-only: no code, no build.

acceptanceCriteria.text: CLAUDE.md’s command-surface bullet no longer claims the whole eight-code family is "mapped once in EXIT_CODES"; it either names EXIT_OK/EXIT_UNCAUGHT plus exitCodeTaxonomy(), or defers the split to src/errors.ts and src/contract.ts.
The bullet still names all eight exit codes and their meanings, so GCLI-16’s outcome does not regress.
Docs, Tracker integrity and Check all pass on the head that carries the change.
